title: Theramenes
summary: Raleigh names Theramenes in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Theramenes, one of the thirtie Tyrants of Athens, who disliked their effusion of bloud, and was compelled by Critias to drinke poyson. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter IX, §. II, sig. 435a–435b
